## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue and
state acceptance criteria using synthetic examples.

## Validation

List relevant commands and results. Identify remaining live integration gates.
Do not attach credentials, customer documents, tenant identifiers or private traces.

## Compatibility and security

Describe API/configuration changes, migration steps, dependency changes and affected
identity, authorization, approval, telemetry or cleanup boundaries.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is limited to the harness and approved supporting files.
- [ ] Privacy/history and distribution checks pass; no private material is staged.
- [ ] Relevant tests, lint, formatting, runtime gates and offline demo pass.
- [ ] Public documentation and configuration examples reflect the change.
- [ ] Live enforcement claims have reviewed source evidence, or remain explicitly pending.
